I'm working through each candidate entity, starting with "X-linked Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy." It's a specific form tied to the emerin gene, so I'm leaning toward labeling it SpecificDisease, though it could arguably fit as a broader disease class.

I'm going through the remaining candidates: "Emery-Dreifuss muscular dystrophy" and its abbreviation "EMD" are both specific disease mentions, and I'm treating the X-linked form as one as well, since it names a single defined disease. The clinical features like ankle contractures and muscle weakness are symptoms rather than disease names, so I'm leaving them unannotated.
